tools.name: search_policies
tools.description: Find Indian insurance products by words in the name, insurer (slug), type of insurance (category slug from list_categories), line (life, health, general) or status (active, withdrawn). A UIN in q returns that product. Start here when you only have a name.

tools.name: find_policies
tools.description: Shortlist active policies of one type by what their documents say, e.g. health cover with a pre-existing disease wait of at most 24 months and lifelong renewal, or 60+ days of pre-hospitalisation. Conditions are on the category's bool, duration and number fields (keys and units from list_categories

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Everything about one product by UIN: each fact read from its documents (waiting periods, limits, co-pay, exclusions, claims, renewal rights...) with the verbatim policy para (field `quote`), the clause and page it came from, its check status, and the law behind it; plus its documents, versions, wher

tools.name: search_policy_text
tools.description: Full-text search inside one product's documents (wording, prospectus, CIS) for words like 'cataract', 'air ambulance', 'suicide'. Returns matching clauses with page and link. Use when get_policy does not cover the question.

tools.name: get_policy_clause
tools.description: The exact text of one clause by clause_id (from get_policy sources or search_policy_text), with its pages and the product it belongs to.

tools.name: compare_policies
tools.description: Two to four products side by side on the same fields, with differences flagged and each value sourced. Products of the same category compare best. Nothing is scored: explain the trade-offs to the user.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The types of insurance (health, critical illness, term life, ULIP, motor, home, travel...) with slugs and product counts. With category, the fields read for that type and what each means.

tools.name: get_insurer
tools.description: An insurer by slug (or all insurers without one): registration, type, claim and complaint record by year with source, claim and grievance contacts, and its products.

tools.name: search_insurance_law
tools.description: Indian insurance law: the Insurance Act, IRDAI regulations and master circulars, ombudsman rules. Without slug: the instruments, and with q the sections that hold the most of its words (each with its text and link); with slug, the instrument with all its sections and plain-language notes.

tools.name: insurer_contacts
tools.description: How to reach an insurer for claims and complaints: claim and cashless desks, customer care, grievance e-mails, the Grievance Redressal Officer, senior citizen desks, escalation, with each value's source page and date. Use the value exactly; tell the user to check the source.

tools.name: complaint_path
tools.description: The step-by-step route to resolve a claim or complaint with an insurer: the insurer (reply due in 14 days), its Grievance Redressal Officer, IRDAI Bima Bharosa, the Insurance Ombudsman office for the user's state (free, up to Rs 50 lakh, within a year) and the consumer commission, each with contacts

tools.name: draft_complaint
tools.description: A complaint letter ready to send, to the insurer (level insurer), its Grievance Redressal Officer (gro) or the Insurance Ombudsman (ombudsman, in the form Rule 14 requires), with to/cc addresses, subject, body and a mailto link. Ask the user for the facts; leave [BRACKETS] for anything unknown. Noth

tools.name: find_forms
tools.description: An insurer's forms: claim forms, complaint and grievance forms, service requests (nominee, refund, surrender, KYC) and proposal forms, with field counts and the original PDF.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: One form, field by field as printed: sections, each field's label, type, whether required and what to write; documents to attach; where to send it; deadlines; and, for fillable PDFs, the PDF's own field names. Walk the user through it one field at a time; never invent answers.

tools.name: request_help
tools.description: Send the user's request to IndiaInsurances' team (support@indiainsurances.com) for free help buying, porting, a claim or a policy review; the team replies by e-mail. ASK THE USER FIRST and set consent true only if they agree to be contacted. Details are not passed to any insurer, agent or broker.

tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Tell IndiaInsurances a fact is wrong or outdated, with evidence (document and page) if possible. Ask the user before sending anything they wrote.

tools.name: about_dataset
tools.description: What IndiaInsurances holds: counts of insurers, products, products read clause by clause, documents and facts, and the data date.

tools.name: search_registered_agents
tools.description: Find an IRDAI-registered corporate agent, broker, TPA, insurance marketing firm, web aggregator, surveyor or repository from the regulator's published lists. For an individual person (licence number) use search_individual_agents. Phone and e-mail are masked.

tools.name: get_registered_agent
tools.description: One row from IRDAI's published intermediary lists, by kind slug and row slug from search_registered_agents. A copy of the list, not the live licence. Phone and e-mail masked.

tools.name: search_individual_agents
tools.description: Find an individual insurance agent on IRDAI's public Agent Locator copy. q is a licence number (zero-padded to 6 digits: 001739 not 1739), a name, an agent ID or a PIN. A licence number is fetched live from IRDAI if we do not hold it yet. Phone and mobile are masked. A miss is not proof the person i

tools.name: get_individual_agent
tools.description: Appointments for one IRDAI individual-agent licence number (life, general and health can each be a row). A copy of the Agent Locator, not the live licence. Phone and mobile masked.
